title: Cohesion without memorised templates
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply cohesion without memorised templates in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 用有逻辑的分组描述自编数据：线上借阅 10→30%，纸本借阅 80→60%，其他 10→10%。
grammar: cohesion 来自信息组织，不是每句添加 moreover。this shift 需有清晰先行内容，while 可合并对照趋势。不要用 complicated synonyms 换掉技术含义稳定的借阅类别。
common_mistake: 为了避免重复，把 borrowing 改为 purchasing 会改变指标。

reading: Paper loans remained the dominant category in the fictional distribution. Their share fell from 80% to 60%, while digital borrowing rose from 10% to 30%. The remaining category stayed at 10%. This shift therefore involved the two main formats rather than all categories equally. Grouping the opposing trends in one sentence makes the comparison visible. A separate sentence can then report the stable category. Repeating the exact category names is preferable to replacing them with terms that imply a different activity.

questions.prompt: What does this shift refer to ?
questions.answer: The redistribution from paper towards digital borrowing.
questions.explanation: 指代前句两种份额变化，不是所有类别增长。

questions.prompt: Did digital borrowing become the largest category ?
questions.answer: No, paper remained at 60%, above digital's 30%.
questions.explanation: 增长最快不等于规模最大。
